label: Harvest: base spawn interval (ms)
description: Time between spawns at a node with zero idle heroes and no tool upgrade. 45000 = 45s. Halved from the original 90s alongside baseYieldPerCatch being halved -- spawn twice as often, worth half as much each, more clicks for a similar per-hour total rather than a straight buff or nerf.

label: Harvest: minimum spawn interval (ms)
description: Soft floor -- idle-hero count and tool level can shrink the interval, but never past this, so a node never spawns faster than one item every 10s regardless of roster size. Halved from 20s alongside baseSpawnIntervalMs, same reasoning.

label: Harvest: spawn reduction per idle hero (ms)
description: Shaved off the spawn interval per hero currently not on a quest, before the minimum floor above is applied.

label: Harvest: despawn window (ms)
description: How long a spawned item sits before it despawns unclicked. No penalty for a miss -- it just goes away and the node starts counting down to its next spawn.

label: Harvest: bonus glint chance (%)
description: Chance a given spawn is a bigger, rarer "bonus" glint worth harvest.bonusMultiplier times the normal yield.

label: Harvest: bonus glint multiplier
description: Yield multiplier on a bonus glint catch.

label: Harvest: base yield per catch
description: Flat, predictable material gained per normal catch before any tool-upgrade bonus. Halved from the original 1:1 alongside baseSpawnIntervalMs/minSpawnIntervalMs being halved -- twice as many catches for half the yield each, so per-hour totals land close to where they were, but the loop asks for closer to double the clicks. Can be fractional (materials accumulate exactly, only display formatting rounds); scaled later purely by upgrades, not by RNG.

label: Harvest: sell price per unit
description: Flat gold per material unit sold, once Trade Route is unlocked.

label: Harvest: base warehouse capacity
description: Per-material storage cap at Warehouse level 0. Shared across all four materials -- there's one Warehouse, not four.

label: Warehouse: base cost
description: Cost of the first Warehouse capacity upgrade.

label: Warehouse: cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level.

label: Warehouse: max level
description: Highest level the Warehouse upgrade can reach.

label: Warehouse: capacity per level
description: Added to the per-material storage cap per Warehouse level.

label: Trade Route: cost
description: One-time gold cost to unlock selling materials for gold.

description: Cost of the first Pickaxe upgrade.

label: Quests: over-level attempt penalty (% per level)
description: Success-chance penalty applied per level a hero is BELOW a quest's own reqLevel, when they attempt it anyway. Sending on a quest above your level is allowed (only auto-queue/pickBestQuest still restricts itself to quests a hero already qualifies for) -- this is what makes doing so a real trade rather than a free pass. 10 means a hero 3 levels under a quest's reqLevel loses 30 percentage points of success attempting it, on top of everything else. Existing MIN_SUCCESS/MAX_SUCCESS clamps (5-95) still apply, so it's always technically attemptable, never literally impossible or free.

label: Pets: Common egg hatch XP
description: Total hero XP (earned anywhere in the guild) a Common-rarity egg needs before it hatches.

label: Pets: Uncommon egg hatch XP
description: Total hero XP an Uncommon-rarity egg needs before it hatches.

label: Pets: Rare egg hatch XP
description: Total hero XP a Rare-rarity egg needs before it hatches.

label: Pets: Epic egg hatch XP
description: Total hero XP an Epic-rarity egg needs before it hatches.

label: Pets: Legendary egg hatch XP
description: Total hero XP a Legendary-rarity egg needs before it hatches.

label: Pets: base incubation slots
description: How many eggs can incubate at once before any Nest Expansion levels. Starts at 1 on purpose -- the 2nd nest is meant to be an early Nest Expansion purchase, not free. A dropped egg beyond capacity goes to storage unequipped rather than being lost -- see PetManager.grantEgg.

label: Pets: bonus roll, minimum
description: Lower bound of a freshly-hatched pet's random baseBonusValue, in the same units as the rolled Modifiers key (flat points for success/loot, % multiplier for gold/xp).

label: Pets: bonus roll, maximum
description: Upper bound of a freshly-hatched pet's random baseBonusValue.

label: Pets: xp needed per pet level
description: Flat xp-per-level curve for pets (deliberately simpler than the hero xpForLevel curve -- see PetManager.levelForXp).

label: Pets: bonus growth per pet level
description: Added on top of baseBonusValue per pet level -- this is the only thing post-hatch pet xp currently does (see guild-idler-status.md's Pets section).

label: Pets: % of quest xp shared to each equipped pet
description: Each currently-equipped pet gains this % of a quest's raw xp reward as its own pet xp, independent of which hero actually went. Benched pets gain nothing -- this is the actual reason to equip one.

label: Pets: happiness decay per hour
description: Happiness points lost per real hour, computed lazily from happinessUpdatedAt rather than ticked every second -- see PetManager.currentHappiness.

label: Pets: minimum effective happiness %
description: A starved pet's bonus is scaled down as happiness falls, but never below this floor -- a neglected pet still contributes something, it just isn't at its best.

label: Pets: material feed batch size
description: How many units of a chosen raw Harvest material one 'feed' action consumes.

label: Pets: happiness gained from raw materials
description: Happiness gained per feedMaterialBatchSize of a raw material -- the cheaper, smaller-gain feed option (see pets.feedCraftedHappinessGain for the crafted alternative).

label: Pets: happiness gained from crafted pet treats
description: Happiness gained per crafted Pet Treat -- the pricier, bigger-gain feed option.

label: Pets: egg drop chance, Easy quests (%)
description: Flat % chance a successful Easy-tier quest drops an ordinary egg into storage (Uncommon rarity). Deliberately very low -- a genuine rare find, not a routine drop.

label: Pets: egg drop chance, Normal quests (%)
description: Flat % chance a successful Normal-tier quest drops an ordinary egg (Rare rarity). Deliberately very low.

label: Pets: egg drop chance, Hard quests (%)
description: Flat % chance a successful Hard-tier quest drops an ordinary egg (Epic rarity). Deliberately very low.

label: Pets: egg drop chance, Epic quests (%)
description: Flat % chance a successful Epic-tier quest drops an ordinary egg (Legendary rarity). Deliberately very low.

label: Pets: egg drop chance, Legendary quests (%)
description: Flat % chance a successful Legendary-tier quest drops an ordinary egg (Legendary rarity). Deliberately very low.
